symptom_duration.unit_status: Inferred from magnitude and minute-aligned values; no source unit metadata
symptom_duration.decision: Treat as seconds: the observed minimum becomes minutes and maximum months. Interpreting these magnitudes as hours/days is implausible. Retain hours/days for inspection and log1p(hours) as the duration feature. Confirm with source owner before operational use.

bp_pair_inconsistency.rule: diastolic_bp >= systolic_bp: set both to missing

cleaning.vital_threshold_policy: Conservative fixed technical screening bounds, not normal ranges or clinical cutoffs; not learned from this dataset. Preserve extreme in-range values; require domain review. Missing values remain missing for train-only pipeline imputation.
